title: Initial repetition configuration
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Turing machine with states entry and exit, let $x,s$ be Boolean words, and let $N$ be a natural number. The initial configuration of the repetition controller on input $x$, with state word $s$ on its argument tapes and a separate unary clock of length $N$, is the repetition configuration in its start phase with word $s$ and clock cursor zero.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $C$ and states entry and exit
replaced: For every clean-call machine, controls, input, state word, and count $N$, the configuration assembled from the repetition argument words at the controller's start equals the repetition seam at the test phase with cursor zero.
